question.description: One decision to put to the developer, as Luke would ask it aloud, such as "Should a withdrawn invite tell the invitee who withdrew it?"

recommendation.description: The answer you recommend, and why in a few words, such as "No: just say the invite is no longer valid, so nobody learns who removed them."

path.description: The file, relative to the plan's folder root, such as "src/members/invite.ts".

startLine.description: The first line you are talking about, counted from 1.

endLine.description: The last line you are talking about; the same as startLine for one line. Leave both out to show the file from its top.

code.description: Code the question is about, shown on the developer's screen as Luke asks it.
